zh-Hans: 请重点体验 Office 的连续书写、静止点按、双指缩放、取消后续写，以及保存重开和手记缩略图中的笔迹。画中画背景音乐新增晨光、深蓝和星河，可切换试听并保留偏好。请反馈真实 Apple Pencil 的跟手、压感及误触表现。
en-US: Try continuous Office writing, stationary pen dots, two-finger zoom, writing after cancellation, and ink after save/reopen and in Notes thumbnails. PiP adds First Light, Deep Blue and Starfield, with switching, preview and saved preferences. Please report physical Apple Pencil responsiveness, pressure and palm rejection.
